metas.name: 1 knot - Northwestern
metas.note:
The tent with 2 straps and a single knot in the straps covers most of northwestern Mongolia.

NOTE: Occasionally, camera stitching can hide the knot.

Unfortunately the default single knot tent strap covers quite a large area because of this using other clues is recommended.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: 1 knot to the right - Uliastai to the Mongolian Sands
metas.note: From Uliastai to the Mongolian Sands the knot on the strap is distinctly aligned right. Getting this may require a bit of interpretation but with enough practice is easily get-able.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 2 straps, knots left - Uliastai - Totosengel
metas.note: From just outside Uliastai to the intersection south of Telmen and around Tosontsengel you will find that the knot on the closer strap is very close to the left side of the car.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: 2 straps, knots middle - southwestern
metas.note: The tent with a knot on both straps covers most of southwestern Mongolia.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 2 straps, no knot (perfectly packed) - Hasagt - Altai
metas.note: From the bend in the road near the place name Hasagt to the outskirts of Altai features a perfectly packed tent. This has no knots and none of the straps should be twisted(I haven’t fully checked this so feel free to contact me about it).
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 2 straps, open tent - Southeast of Totosengel
metas.note: In the stretch just after Tosontsengel you can find a variant of the open tent car. This one features only 2 straps on the car.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 4 straps no knot - Taishir - Biger
metas.note: 4 straps with no visible knot can be found between Taishir and Biger.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 4 straps, knot in the middle - around Tseterleg
metas.note: The tent features four straps and two knots where one of the knots is closer to the centre than the right.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 4 straps, knot to the right - around Kharkhorin
metas.note: Mainly found around Kharkhorin is a four strap tent with both knots aligned on the right.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: 4 straps, open tent - around Khorgo
metas.note: The final section bridging the open tent and the four straps coverage is found on the road around Khorgo and features both the open tent and the four straps.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Altai messy straps - only Altai
metas.note: A lot of the Messy Straps coverage in Altai features this strange black blur on the side of the car.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: black object - southeast of Ulaangom
metas.note: Similar to the water bottle on a section of road leading to Ulaangom there is a mysterious black object.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: messy strap, zipper left - West of Bayankhongor
metas.note: The messy strap is just a bundle of straps on the closer left strap. The messy straps are the most common being seen all the way from Altai to Ulaanbaatar. If the zipper is in the left corner of the tent(see image below) then you are west of Bayankhongor.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: messy strap, zipper right - Bayankhongor - Ulaanbaatar
metas.note: The messy strap is just a bundle of straps on the closer left strap. The messy straps are the most common being seen all the way from Altai to Ulaanbaatar. If the zipper is closer to the middle then you are east of Bayankhongor.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: open tent merged straps - between the other open tents
metas.note: On this part of the road right after the two straps you can find that the tent straps are all merged into one.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Ulaanbaatar car - only around the capital
metas.note: Generation 4 coverage in the capital uses a silver truck with an ornate blue & white roof decal, with a snorkel and long antenna on the front right. While the unique roof can be seen in most locations, some locations blur most of the car, leaving only the snorkel and antenna visible. This car can only be found around Ulaanbaatar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Uliastai car - only in Uliastai
metas.note: Around the town of Uliastai you can find a very flat and empty tent. As well as the tent being visibly empty you may also see the front part of the basket which is not super common in the rest of the gen 4 coverage.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: water bottle - Hüryee - Songino
metas.note: From the edge of Khyargas lake to Songino a plastic water bottle can be seen hanging out of the google car.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.
